Use AI in psychiatric wards only in narrow contexts following robust legal processes, careful deliberation, and ongoing reappraisal.
Plan surveillance carefully, considering whether it is legitimate, necessary, and proportionate, and consider less restrictive alternatives to AI-CCTV.
Conduct privacy impact assessments before implementing AI surveillance in psychiatric wards.
Plan carefully before deploying AI tracking systems in psychiatric ward environments, accounting for the ward's physical characteristics.
